note: A `to` on a pass that is neither the last nor one whose `from` is a position (SPEC 3.3.3, the rule for `from` and `to`, rule 4). The value is right: the first pass does leave ab at b. It is a second spelling of a fact the walk already states, so the chain is dropped, and a reader that checks only whether the walk joins reads it clean. The diagnostic names the forbidden key. This is the `to` half of the rule; `walk-spelling.vnx` pins the `from` half.

diagnostics.message_advisory: `to` appears only on the last pass, or on a pass whose `from` is a position — the chain is dropped
